name: CloudHealth by VMware
tagline: CloudHealth by VMware is a multi-cloud management platform for optimizing costs, security posture, and performance across AWS, Azure, and GCP from a single interface. FinOps and cloud operations teams use it to set budget alerts, identify idle resources, enforce governance policies, and track cloud spend by team or project. It provides detailed rightsizing recommendations and can enforce tagging compliance across accounts to keep cost allocation clean.
